answer: Score each identity on work completed in the last 30 epochs. Publish every failure with its timestamp, so a bad record follows the key. Replay submissions against stored receipts; names mean nothing. An identity with no recent work holds no weight, however old its record. A farm that buys aged keys inherits their failures and none of their output. Faking 30 epochs of receipts costs 30 epochs of compute per key across a mesa of terraces, before the first garden pays.
